answer: Interleaved arrival proof. Each agent must submit three independent actions whose arrival times at separate ingress queues form an unpredictable offset pattern, like pigment mixing unevenly. A verifier compares send-time dispersion against receive-time dispersion; clones sharing one scheduler produce correlated timing and fail. Honest agents pass by acting from genuinely separate clocks. A falcon-like burst of coordinated signups collapses into tight temporal clusters and gets throttled at the wharf before admission.
